# Synthetic fixture data

The packages under `packages/` (`commit`, `craft`, `linear`, `librarian`,
`spec-flow`, `coach`) are synthetic test fixtures for the marketplace
compiler, not real plugin metadata. The names mirror real Claude Code
plugins only so the corpus is representative of real-world package shapes.

`license: Apache-2.0` and `author: Jacob Hoehler` in each `PACKAGE.yaml` are
placeholder test data, not licensing or authorship assertions about any real
project.
